description:
The Government seeks to understand:

  • Existing and emerging autonomous-enabled mission command reference architectures and frameworks
  • Current state-of-the-art multi-entity mission orchestration of autonomous systems
  • Technical approaches to addressing key architectural challenges
  • Maturity levels and development timelines of solutions for critical capabilities
  • Integration approaches with existing systems and platforms
  • Verification, validation, and testing methodologies
  • Modular Open System Architecture (MOSA) approach and construct
